def solve(inputs):
    X = inputs['initial_value']
    shifts = [(13, 9), (17, 0)]  # Only one shift is needed here for the final xorshift operation
    rounds = inputs['rounds']
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF

    for round in range(rounds):
        for left_shift, right_shift in shifts:
            X ^= (X << left_shift) & mask
            X ^= (X >> right_shift)
            X ^= (X << left_shift) & mask
    
    return X
